image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a rocky substrate. The organism has an elongated oval shape with a distinct dorsal surface featuring eight overlapping calcareous plates arranged in a linear series. The plates are yellowish-green with brownish mottling and visible growth lines. Surrounding the plates is a tough, leathery girdle that appears slightly hairy or spiny. The background consists of dark, textured rock with some algae or marine growth.
